annotations.title: Which reason to buy do people search for, and which is growing?

description: Use when the user is choosing a positioning, a message or a campaign angle and asks which benefit or reason to buy matters most to buyers, or which is gaining. Returns, for each angle searched with the category, its share of searches among the angles named, its year-on-year change and its growth beyond an everyday control basket, with a volume band. Shares and bands only. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.07 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For brands' shares of search, use run_share_of_search; for whether competitors already claim an angle, use run_claim_check. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/angle-demand.json
